morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整敬称词记忆，不拆成 bagi + -nda；所列读音采用马来半岛常见词尾 a 弱化为 /ə/ 的形式，也有保留 /a/ 的规范读法。无常用的生产性派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 用于第三人称指称君主、哈里发或使者先知的尊称代词；指君主时相当于“陛下”。
senses.en_definition: An honorific third-person pronoun referring to a monarch, caliph, or prophet; His or Her Majesty when referring to a monarch.
senses.ms_definition: Kata ganti diri ketiga bagi raja, khalifah atau rasul.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是 kata ganti nama diri ketiga，即第三人称代词；因给定 pos 枚举没有 pronoun，此处用 noun 作名词类归档。可指男性或女性。用于先知时，英文通常依语境译为 he 或 the Prophet，不译为 His Majesty。[DBP：baginda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=baginda)

collocations.en: His or Her Majesty delivers a royal address
His or Her Majesty graciously consents

senses.zh_definition: 置于国王或苏丹姓名、头衔之前的尊称。
senses.en_definition: An honorific title placed before the name or designation of a king or sultan.
senses.ms_definition: Kata yang digunakan sebagai gelaran di pangkal nama seseorang raja atau sultan.
senses.nuances: 此用法见《Kamus Pelajar》，常见于历史叙述及王室称谓；完整正式称号须遵照相应王室礼制。[DBP：baginda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=baginda)

collocations.zh: 陛下（正式王室尊称组成部分）
collocations.en: His or Her Majesty, as part of a formal royal style

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sultan berkenan menghadiri majlis tersebut, dan baginda turut menyampaikan sumbangan kepada penduduk setempat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 苏丹陛下欣然出席该仪式，并向当地居民发放援助。
dual_scenarios.en: The Sultan graciously attended the ceremony, and His Majesty also presented aid to local residents.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tengok berita tadi. Sultan dah sampai kat pusat pemindahan, dan baginda tengah jumpa mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya menonton berita tadi. Sultan sudah tiba di pusat pemindahan, dan baginda sedang bertemu dengan mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚看了新闻。苏丹已经到疏散中心了，陛下正在探望灾民。
dual_scenarios.en: I just watched the news. The Sultan has arrived at the evacuation centre, and His Majesty is meeting flood victims.
spoken_features: tengok 与 jumpa 是日常表达
谈话可以口语化，指称君主时仍保留 baginda

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku tengok berita tadi. Sultan dah sampai kat pusat pemindahan, dan baginda tengah jumpa mangsa banjir.
messages.ms_standard: Saya menonton berita tadi. Sultan sudah tiba di pusat pemindahan, dan baginda sedang bertemu dengan mangsa banjir.
messages.zh: 我刚看了新闻。苏丹已经到疏散中心了，陛下正在探望灾民。
messages.en: I just watched the news. The Sultan has arrived at the evacuation centre, and His Majesty is meeting flood victims.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku nampak juga. Baginda ada sampaikan bantuan sekali, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya juga melihat berita itu. Baginda turut menyampaikan bantuan, bukan?
messages.zh: 嗯，我也看到了。陛下也发放了援助，对吧？
messages.en: Yes, I saw that too. His Majesty handed out aid as well, didn't he?

etymology.historical_story: Baginda belongs to the courtly vocabulary inherited by modern Malay. Etymological accounts associate it with Sanskrit expressions of fortune or distinction, although the exact source form is not consistently identified. Its continuing role is clear: it marks respectful reference to a sovereign, and Malay dictionaries also extend that reverence to caliphs and prophets. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/baginda), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=baginda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“ba-gin-da，背后说陛下”：向别人谈君主用 baginda；直接向君主说话时常用 Tuanku。这里的“背后”只表示第三人称转述。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: baginda 是谈及君主时使用的第三人称敬称；直接称呼君主通常用 Tuanku。正式表达应配合 bertitah、berkenan 等适当王室用语。[DBP：第三人称称谓说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membuatkan)
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于相关王室、历史及宗教语境，不是对普通上司、长辈或名人的通用敬称。口语交流中仍可保留其尊敬语气；完整头衔及大小写遵循相应官方或编辑规范。
